back_translation: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad; the desert Arabah will rejoice and blossom like a rose.

It will bloom abundantly and rejoice with gladness and the sound of singing. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, along with the splendor of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of the LORD, the splendor of our God.
Strengthen the weary hands and make firm the feeble knees.
Say to those whose hearts are fearful: "Be strong; do not be afraid! Behold, your God will come with vengeance, with the righteous recompense of God. He will come and save you."
Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will hear.
Then the lame will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing for joy. For waters will burst forth in the wilderness, and streams will flow in the desert Arabah.
The scorching ground will become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water. In the haunt where jackals once lay down, grass, reeds, and papyrus will grow.
And there will be a highway there, a way that will be called the Way of Holiness. The unclean will not travel on it; it will belong to those who walk in that way, and fools will not stray onto it.
No lion will be there, and no ferocious beast will go up on it; none will be found there. But the redeemed will walk there.

And those whom the LORD has ransomed will return and enter Zion with singing. Everlasting joy will be a crown upon their heads; gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.
